description:
Perform a green screen removal (chroma keying) on a provided raw footage plate. 

1. Import the image located at '/home/ga/assets/greenscreen_plate.jpg' into the Blender Compositor.
2. Use the 'Keying' node (or equivalent chroma key nodes) to remove the green background.
3. Configure the render settings to export as PNG with RGBA (Alpha channel enabled) to preserve transparency.
4. Render the image and save it to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/keyed_subject.png'.
5. Save the Blender project as '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/chroma_key.blend'.
